mappings.note: 'Each and every member ___ to vote' -- subject-verb agreement, grammar; LO-36 covers grammar games, not drills.
'A large number of soldiers ___ died for the country' -- subject-verb agreement.
'Half of the class ___ empty' -- agreement with a partitive subject.
'Physics ___ difficult to understand' -- agreement with a subject that is plural in form only.
'The quality of food here ___ gone down' -- agreement across an intervening phrase.
